g.text: H Direct SNP-channel IG | next FEV₁
Healthy and COPD | performance and model interpretation
Task colors: FEV₁ (blue), FVC (coral), FEV₁/FVC (teal). A1–A3 and B1–B3: separate tasks in original units; matched axes by task.
C–D bands: 500 patient bootstraps. E–F: native clinical attribution Top 10; Healthy linear + neural IG, COPD affine branch.
G–H show direct SNP input-channel IG only; PRS and clinical-SNP paths excluded. Different designs / inputs limit specificity claims.
